text.text: Fantastic food. I had a vegetarian Greek omelet (without green onion, onion, and garlic), and my friends had hummus, french fries. and a pasta. My Greek omelet is full of vegetables and utterly delicious! And l saw the sign next to the entrance that this is a "women and children friendly restaurant", which means the facilities and ingredients are extra safe for kids and women, and they don't use any plastics that leach out Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (EDC). The only thing that I don't like was the music was a bit too loud.

text.text: Lovely place to have some casual food- a bit different from all the typical street food around this area! People were very friendly, Jenson who served us was super helpful and very considerate. This is a place that we can relax, sit and talk while enjoying the food (very tasty!) in this chaotic, popular district.

text.text: After a couple weeks traveling throughout Asia we needed a change in flavor for a night. This was great! We ordered the Toasteria Salad with a local cheese option, octopus, cheesy potatoes and chicken shawarma. It was all delicious and we only wished we’d had space for more. It was pricey but given how little we’d spent at food markets and little restaurants we could afford the splurge. The staff were so friendly and helpful. It exceeded all our expectations and if we make it back to Taiwan we’ll come back again. Pretty good endorsement to seek out Mediterranean food in Taiwan!
